column2: added the rest of the ZEN set: 124 cards, 20 lands and 45 enemies, so all 229 ZEN cards now have a role (155 player cards, 20 lands, 54 enemies); cards made of effects with their text built from them in Korean and English; allies and rally, quests, 10 more traps; encounters rolled each run from a roster for each place; the way into Kabira and the Makindi camp may be watched; 412 tuning values added to config.js, none of the first build's moved
